# Street PRO Garage

> Custom-built remote ECU tuning worldwide, rolling road dyno tuning in Manchester, UK, custom ECU wiring/installation, and performance parts sales & fitting. A second workshop in Karachi, Pakistan handles dyno tuning and full engine swaps/builds. No generic Stage 1/2/3 kits — every tune is written from scratch for the specific vehicle, parts, fuel and goals.

## Locations

- Manchester, United Kingdom — rolling road dyno tuning, remote tuning, custom wiring, performance parts sales & fitting.
- Karachi, Pakistan — dyno tuning, remote tuning, custom wiring, engine swaps & builds.
- Remote ECU tuning is available worldwide regardless of location.

## Platforms & Vehicles

- Stock ECU reflashing via HP Tuners and Hondata, across Honda, Subaru and Mitsubishi Evo platforms (HP Tuners credit-locked, purchased separately by the customer).
- Honda-specific platforms: P28 (chipped), Hondata S300, Hondata KPro, Hondavert, HTS, Neptune RTP — covering D-series, B-series, H-series, F-series, K-series and R-series Civic, Integra, CRX, Del Sol and Prelude builds.
- Nissan-specific: Nistune (stock ECU reflash) — SR20DET Pulsar GTiR, Sentra and Sunny platforms.
- Standalone ECUs: AEM Infinity, Link ECU, MaxxECU, Haltech, Speeduino, Megasquirt (tuned via TunerStudio), ME (Motorsport Electronics), EcuMaster (including DET3+).
- Honda: D16, B16, B18, B20, H22, H23, F20B/F22/F23, K20, K24, R18 — Civic, CRX, Del Sol, Prelude (OBD1 and K/R-series), including mini D16 swaps.
- Toyota: MR2 Turbo (3SGTE), Supra (2JZGTE), and 2ZZ-GE — AEM Infinity or EcuMaster.
- Mitsubishi: Lancer Evo I–III, IV–VI and VIII–IX (4G63T) — stock ECU, AEM Infinity, MegaSquirt or MaxxECU standalone.
- Subaru: Impreza WRX & STI — UK 2000 model, 2001–05 (with race ROM upgrade), and 2006-onward models.
- Nissan: Pulsar GTiR (SR20DET) — stock ECU on Nistune, or Link ECU standalone.
- Mazda: Miata/MX-5, naturally aspirated, turbo and supercharged.
- Plus other JDM engine swaps and platforms on request — if it's got an ECU we can talk to, we can very likely tune it.
- Fuel types supported: Pump Gas Premium, E85, and Flex Fuel (blend of both).

## Stuck or Incomplete Builds

- A common job: diagnosing a stalled project, a half-finished swap, or a car another shop couldn't get running/tuned. Send the build list and we assess where it stands rather than starting over.

## Policies Worth Knowing

- Dyno time is billed separately from the tune price — not included in the flat tuning fee.
- Free tune revisions within 14 days of the final tune; chargeable after that window.
- Road tuning requires the vehicle to be in safe, roadworthy condition (brakes, tyres, steering, suspension) since it involves driving at speed on public roads to gather datalogs.
